scoring.reason: Source resource names are not unique observable acceptance leaves; no complete behavior baseline or independent freeze exists.

gaps.evidence: Registry IDs and data file paths name resources but do not enumerate all gameplay behaviors. Wiki page revision metadata was retrieved; the subsequent revision-content request returned HTTP 403.
gaps.missing: Version-applicable full behavior/manual source index and source-to-behavior coverage, including survival, physics, AI, redstone, progression, modes, multiplayer and save/reload.

gaps.evidence: summary.json lists all 54 data definitions absent from their corresponding empty registry arrays: 34 worldgen structures, 13 structure tags and 7 experimental structure tags.
gaps.missing: Independent confirmation against the exact original version; zero-length extracted registries must not remove these content concepts.

gaps.evidence: Catalog includes resource concepts, assets, internal types, variants and metadata; raw row counts would double-count or distort gameplay contribution.
gaps.missing: Stable acceptance leaf IDs, one behavior owner, uniform positive integer weight rationale, exact acceptance steps, system grouping and fixed full denominator.

gaps.evidence: Both bundled optional experiment packs are retained in separate catalog categories; no full mode/feature-flag applicability audit was performed.
gaps.missing: Documented version-applicable mode boundaries and source-backed inclusion or exclusion decisions, without reducing the game to a convenient subset.

gaps.evidence: No gameplay acceptance was run or claimed.
gaps.missing: Complete major-system gates and a frozen new-game-to-progression-to-save-to-reload continuous route with inputs and observable failure conditions.

gaps.evidence: Only the author's deterministic source projection has been checked; both mcmeta views share one upstream extraction.
gaps.missing: Non-author source coverage, granularity, weights and critical-gate review before formal freezing.

gaps.evidence: D28 and preceding platform capabilities are not fully accepted; this source preparation did not execute a platform game project.
gaps.missing: Accepted platform, locked game environment, platform Project/Task/Agent/Execution/review/Artifact links, actual implementation, evidence manifest and replay/playtest.
